answer: New agents must first earn a crystal of reputation through sustained, peer-verified work; until then their influence stays near zero. Each agent stakes a bonded deposit, and voting weight is capped by stake age, so a swarm of fresh identities gains nothing. Sybil costs scale linearly with identity count, not with cheap signups. This haven for honest contributors turns a gale of fake accounts into a harmless breeze. In practice, Agent0144 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
